tools.name: build_rough_cut
tools.description: Auto-assemble a timed sequence of vintage clips into a video timeline based on a description. Returns an ordered list of clips with durations. Great for creating edit lists or storyboards.

tools.name: check_clip_rights
tools.description: Verify a clip is eligible for a given intended use (commercial, editorial, broadcast, etc.) before licensing.

tools.name: create_4k_checkout
tools.description: Create or resume Stripe hosted checkout for a quoted 4K license. Call ONLY after the user explicitly approves the quoted clip, total price, resolution, license scope, territory, term, and terms. Returns a checkout URL and private order token. tools.name: find_similar_footage
tools.description: Find visually similar vintage clips by providing a clip ID. Returns clips with similar visual content from the Stockfilm archive.

tools.name: get_4k_order
tools.description: Verify a 4K order's payment with Stripe and retrieve the license, receipt, and private master download after payment. Requires the private order token from create_4k_checkout. tools.name: get_clip_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific Stockfilm clip including description, year shot, location, price, resolution, thumbnail URL, and preview URL.

tools.name: license_clip
tools.description: Get licensing options for a clip without charging the user. The website offers 4K masters for eligible clips; the separate x402 product is 144p. Review availability, exact price, and terms on the clip page before purchase. This tool does not issue a license or process payment.

tools.name: quote_4k_license
tools.description: Quote an eligible, unwatermarked 4K master using the website's direct license pricing. Verifies actual resolution and licensing availability. Ask for the buyer email and desired use, territory, and term. Does not charge the user. Show the complete quote and terms before requesting checkout approval.

tools.name: search_vintage_footage
tools.description: Search Stockfilm's archive of authentic vintage home movie clips from the 1930s-1980s. Returns clips with metadata, pricing, thumbnails, and licensing info. All footage is real 8mm/Super 8 film — no AI-generated content.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_4k_order, get_clip_details, license_clip · Private data: create_4k_checkout, get_4k_order · Public sink: check_clip_rights, quote_4k_license.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_4k_order, get_clip_details, license_clip · Private data: create_4k_checkout, get_4k_order · Public sink: check_clip_rights, quote_4k_license

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
